dossier:
1.  If the user needs speed and low cost: Select anima-turbo-v1.1.safetensors. It is a distilled version for fast generations [MODEL.md].
2.  If the user needs high quality and consistency: Select anima-aesthetic-v1.1.safetensors. It is fine-tuned for better consistency and a higher quality default art style [MODEL.md].
3.  If the user needs maximum diversity or is training LoRAs: Select anima-base-v1.0.safetensors. It is the pretrained, unrefined base model [MODEL.md].

templates_list.name: image_anima_preview
templates_list.title: Anima Anime Text-to-Image Generation
templates_list.desc: Input a text prompt to generate an anime-style image using the Anima model. Configure settings like steps and CFG scale to control the output. The workflow produces a non-photorealistic illustration based on your description.

templates_list.name: image_anima_base_v1
templates_list.title: Anima Base v1: Text to Image
templates_list.desc: Input a text prompt describing an anime or artistic illustration. Generate a non-photorealistic image focused on anime concepts, characters, or styles.

templates_list.name: image_anima_lllite_any_control_to_image
templates_list.title: Anima Lllite: Any Control to Image
templates_list.desc: Apply lightweight, LoRA-like conditional control to Anima-Base v1.0 anime-style images using ControlNet-LLLite, accepting one conditioning input and one optional mask for inpainting to produce a single generated output. Ideal for anime inpainting with dynamic masking, style transfer from lineart or grayscale sketches, and controlled character generation in multi-scene compositions.

templates_list.name: image_anima_lllite_depth_control_to_image
templates_list.title: Anima Lllite: Depth Control to Image
templates_list.desc: Generate anime-style illustrations from a depth map using the Anima LLLite model, which applies a lightweight ControlNet correction for precise spatial control. Input 1 image to produce 2 image outputs plus a comparison view. Ideal for 3D scene reconstruction, VFX depth passes, and AR asset preparation.

templates_list.name: image_anima_lllite_image_inpainting
templates_list.title: Anima Lllite: Image Inpainting
templates_list.desc: Inpaint anime images with Anima LLLite, a lightweight ControlNet variant that applies low-rank corrections for precise mask-based editing. Input 1 image and receive 1 inpainted output plus a comparison view. Ideal for fixing character details, removing unwanted objects from anime scenes, and seamless background restoration.
